promo_options.hook: Alexander bursts through the cottage door bleeding heavily, shouting 'It is nothing' when confronted.
promo_options.cliffhanger: Alexander places Juliana's hand against his bare, scarred chest, whispering 'Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain' as she stares back captivated.
promo_options.reasoning: This full-length arc captures the complete transformation from a high-stakes, bloody entrance to a deeply intimate and emotionally charged confession.
